title: Circular No. (26/4/3106) dated 15/2/2022 regarding Annual Report and External Auditors Report for Electronic Payment and Money Transfer Services Companies
text:
)11/01/1/1( جذومن ميحرلا نمحرلا الله مسب
Number: 26/4/3106
Date: 14 Rajab, 1443 AH
Corresponding to: February 15, 2022
Circular to Electronic Payment and Money Transfer Companies
Subject: Annual Report and External Auditor's Report for Electronic
Payment and Money Transfer Services Companies
Greetings,
Pursuant to the provisions of Article (31/A) of the Electronic Payment and Money Transfer
Bylaw No. (111) of 2017, and Article (12/A/1) of the External Audit Instructions for
Electronic Payment and Money Transfer Services Companies No. (7/2018) and their
amendments, we kindly inform you of the necessity to provide us with the company's annual
report, which includes the final accounts certified by the external auditor, along with their
report, in addition to the minutes of the company's general assembly meeting regarding the
final accounts, no later than the end of April each year, taking into account the international
financial reporting standards in its preparation.
We would emphasize the importance of fully adhering to the following:
1- Submit a hard copy of both the company's annual report and the external auditor's report
in accordance with the relevant regulations, in addition to providing us with an electronic
copy in (Excel) format of the company's financial statements to the following email
address:
Payment.dep.Studies@cbj.gov.jo
2- Submit the audited financial statements for your branches and offices located outside the
Kingdom, along with their respective external auditors’ reports.
Respectfully
Governor
Dr. Adel Al- Sharkas
